thread:
sam: Morning — quick capacity check. We need a tiny H100 slot in eu-west1 for a canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC (4h). Can vendor temporarily move 1x H100 from the vendor demo pool into project-redwood-canary? Will tag billing as `canary-q2`. Link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821

maria: @sam do you have quota id + exact time window? also confirm region (eu-west1)? I'll need to add billing tag on the reservation. :memo:

sam: Yep — quota id: project-redwood-canary, window 09:00–13:00 UTC, region eu-west1. gcloud check we usually run: `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=project-redwood-canary` (just FYI).

kevin: Vendor-side note: current demo pool is tight this week. We can probably free 1 H100 if we pull 1 A100 from staging-burst for a short window. @ashley can you pause the nightly loadtest that uses an A100?

ashley: I can cancel the 08:30 nightly loadtest, that would free 1 A100. Need ops approval but should be fine. I'll cancel it at 07:45 and post here. :ok_hand:

maria: Great. I'm going to open the reservation request with vendor now and include `canary-q2` as billing tag. @vendor-agent please confirm whether you can make the 09:00 slot green if staging frees that A100. Also tagging PR: kevin, there's a small terraform tweak to allow short-term pool swaps — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1297 (please review).

kevin: Saw the PR, will do a quick pass by EOD. If we need a hotfix path, I can carve a short-lived IAM role for vendor-handshake.

vendor-agent: Hi @maria @sam — we can provision 1x H100 to `project-redwood-canary` if an A100 is freed from `staging-burst` by 08:30 UTC. ETA for actual handover ~09:00 UTC. Will apply billing tag `canary-q2` on request.

sam: Awesome, thanks. @ashley please confirm once the nightly is cancelled and we'll proceed to schedule the canary.

ashley: Nightly loadtest cancelled at 07:46 UTC, freed 1 A100.

vendor-agent: Confirmed. H100 moved and redeploy scheduled. Canaries should be able to use compute at 09:00 UTC.

oncall-bot: Reminder: any capacity swaps that affect other tenants must be logged in INF-ops with the swap id. Auto-created INF-ops-5092 for this action.

sam: Logged INF-4821 -> INF-ops-5092, updated ticket with vendor confirmation. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for project-redwood-canary @ 09:00 UTC. Monitoring hooks active. :rocket:
